title: Chest pain, classic cardiac
transcript:
Doctor: Good morning, what brings you in?
Patient: I'm 62. An hour ago I got a tightness in my chest that goes down my left arm.
Doctor: Any sweating?
Patient: Yes, I'm all clammy and I feel sick.
Doctor: Any fever?
Patient: No.

title: Chest pain that hurts when pressed
transcript: I'm 34. My chest is sore on the left since I moved furniture at the weekend. It hurts when I press on it. I'm not short of breath and I haven't been sweating.

title: Chest pain after a long flight
transcript:
Patient: I got back yesterday from a 12-hour flight and today I'm short of breath with chest pain.
Doctor: Is it worse when you breathe in deeply?
Patient: Yes, it hurts when I take a deep breath.
Doctor: Any swelling in the legs?
Patient: Yes, my left leg is swollen.

title: Burning chest after dinner
transcript: After a big greasy dinner I get a burning behind my chest and a sour taste in my mouth. It's heartburn every night. It doesn't come on when I walk.

title: Thunderclap headache
transcript:
Patient: I was at the gym and suddenly I got a headache, the worst pain of my life.
Doctor: Can you bend your neck forward?
Patient: No, my neck is stiff.

title: Migraine, as usual
transcript: I've had a headache for two days, on one side, like my usual migraines. Light bothers me and I feel sick. No fever.

title: Stroke told by a relative
transcript:
Patient: My husband's face is drooping on one side and he can't lift his arm.
Doctor: When did it start?
Patient: Suddenly, about 40 minutes ago. His speech is slurred too.

title: Breathless at rest
transcript: I have asthma and I'm wheezing. I'm short of breath even when I'm sitting, I can't finish my sentences.

title: Classic appendicitis
transcript:
Patient: The pain started around my belly button and now it's moved low down on the right.
Doctor: Any vomiting?
Patient: Yes, I threw up twice.
Doctor: Diarrhoea?
Patient: No.

title: Burning on passing urine
transcript: For three days it burns when I pee and I'm going to the toilet all the time. No fever and no blood in my urine.

title: Common cold
transcript: I've got a sore throat and a runny nose since yesterday, and a bit of a cough. I'm not short of breath.

title: Flu
transcript:
Patient: I've had a fever of 39 degrees since yesterday and I'm aching all over.
Doctor: Any chills?
Patient: Yes, I keep shivering.

title: Allergic reaction to a sting
transcript: I was stung by a wasp ten minutes ago and now my lips are swollen and I'm wheezing.

title: Fever and confusion
transcript: Patient: My mother has had a high temperature since this morning and she's very confused, she doesn't know where she is.
